'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3). Informal notebook sheet; title That Thing don't cap damage. Transcription best-effort from dense handwriting.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
